title: Green light means a curse? What 301 spells say

voiceover.text: Green light means a deadly curse. Right?
The Harry Potter Wiki lists three hundred and one spells.
More than half are charms. The rest are mostly jinxes, curses, transfigurations and hexes.
But half of all spells have no colour on record, or no light at all.
That leaves a hundred and forty-two spells with a colour.
Among charms, blue comes first. Then white, red and green.
Among curses, hexes and jinxes, blue comes first too.
So colour alone can't tell you what a spell does.
Green isn't the colour of evil. Nine of sixteen green spells are charms.
Red mostly helps. Ten of fourteen are charms, like Stupefy and Expelliarmus.
The darkest colour is purple. Six of nine are curses, hexes or jinxes.
Even the three Unforgivable Curses don't match: green, red, and no light at all.
We grouped every colour on Querious, with one SQL query.
Count them your way, then download the result, or connect it to your own AI and tools.
Just remember: the colours come from a fan wiki, many from the games, and the groups are ours.
The data is open. The question is yours.
